vocabulary.meaning_en: a short form of two words, with an apostrophe
a helping verb: be, have, do, will, would...
vocabulary.example: "Have" is an auxiliary verb in "I have seen".

vocabulary.meaning_en: a helping verb like will, would, can, could; followed by the base verb
the third form of a verb: seen, gone, been, loved
the simple form of a verb: see, go, love
vocabulary.example: After "will", use the base form: will go.

vocabulary.meaning_en: had (before a past participle) or would (before a base verb)
vocabulary.example: I'd seen it. (had) / I'd see it. (would)

vocabulary.meaning_en: has (before a past participle) or is (before -ing or an adjective)

vocabulary.example: He'll go home in five minutes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a sentence about an imaginary situation, often with "if"
vocabulary.example: "I'd see that movie if it were free" is a conditional.
In "Yes, I am", the verb is stressed.

fine_lines.title: 'd = had or would?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: انظر إلى الفعل بعده: إذا جاء بعده التصريف الثالث فهو had (I'd seen). إذا جاء بعده المصدر فهو would (I'd see). وجود if قد يساعد: I'd ... if.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Look at the next verb: past participle → had (I'd seen). Base form → would (I'd see). "If" in the sentence can be a clue for "would".

examples.sentence: I'd see that movie if it were free. (would)

fine_lines.title: 's = has or is?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: إذا جاء بعده التصريف الثالث فهو has (He's gone). إذا جاء بعده فعل بـ ing أو صفة فهو is (He's going / He's happy).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Past participle after it → has (He's gone). -ing verb or adjective after it → is (He's going / He's happy).

expressions.phrase: I'd call him again if I were you.
expressions.meaning_ar: لو كنت مكانك لاتصلت به مرة أخرى.
expressions.example: He didn't answer? I'd call him again if I were you.

expressions.meaning_en: A short answer; no contraction at the end.
expressions.example: "Are you coming to the meeting?" "Yes, I am."

expressions.phrase: Do you know where it is?
expressions.example: The new library? Do you know where it is?

grammar.title: The contractions
grammar.explanation_ar: have: had → 'd، has → 's، have → 've. be: are → 're، is → 's، am → 'm. الأفعال الناقصة: would → 'd، will → 'll. الفاصلة العليا تعني أن أول الفعل محذوف.
grammar.explanation_en: have: had → 'd, has → 's, have → 've. be: are → 're, is → 's, am → 'm. Modals: would → 'd, will → 'll. The apostrophe means the first part of the verb is missing.

grammar.title: have + past participle
grammar.explanation_ar: إذا جاء بعد الاختصار تصريف ثالث (seen, gone, been, loved) فالاختصار من have.
grammar.explanation_en: If a past participle (seen, gone, been, loved) follows the contraction, it is "have".
examples: I'd seen the movie before. = I had seen
She's been gone for an hour. = She has been

grammar.title: be + -ing or adjective
grammar.explanation_ar: إذا جاء بعد الاختصار فعل بـ ing أو صفة فالاختصار من be.
grammar.explanation_en: If an -ing verb or an adjective follows, it is "be".

grammar.title: will / would + base form
grammar.explanation_ar: الفعل الناقص يتبعه المصدر دائمًا، فإذا جاء بعد 'll أو 'd مصدر فهو will أو would.
grammar.explanation_en: A modal is always followed by the base form, so 'll / 'd + base verb = will / would.
examples: He'll go home. = He will go
I'd see that movie if it were free. = I would see
They'd have been late. = They would have

grammar.title: Don't contract was/past forms or the end of a sentence
grammar.explanation_ar: 's تعني is أو has فقط، ولا تعني was: نقول He was buying ولا نختصرها. ولا نستعمل الاختصار في آخر الجملة لأن الفعل يكون منبورًا: Yes, I am (وليس Yes, I'm). Do you know where it is? (وليس where it's).
grammar.explanation_en: 's means only is or has, never was: "He was buying" can't be contracted. Don't use a contraction at the end of a sentence, because the verb is stressed: "Yes, I am" (not "Yes, I'm"); "Do you know where it is?" (not "where it's").
examples: Do you know where it is?

questions.question: "I'd seen the movie before." Here 'd = ___.
questions.explanation_ar: بعدها تصريف ثالث seen، إذن had.
questions.explanation_en: A past participle (seen) follows, so 'd = had.

questions.question: "I'd see that movie if it were free." Here 'd = ___.
questions.explanation_ar: بعدها مصدر see ومعها if، إذن would.
questions.explanation_en: A base verb (see) and "if" follow, so 'd = would.

questions.question: "He's gone home." Here 's = ___.
questions.explanation_en: "Gone" is a past participle, so 's = has.

questions.question: "He's going home." Here 's = ___.
questions.explanation_ar: بعدها فعل بـ ing، إذن is.

questions.question: "She___ been gone for an hour."
questions.explanation_ar: been تصريف ثالث: she has = she's.
questions.explanation_en: "Been" is a past participle: she has = she's.

questions.question: "Are you going to the party?" Best short answer:
questions.explanation_ar: لا نختصر في آخر الجملة: Yes, I am.
questions.explanation_en: No contraction at the end of a sentence: Yes, I am.

questions.question: Which sentence is wrong?
choices: Do you know where it is?
questions.explanation_ar: لا نستعمل it's في آخر الجملة.
questions.explanation_en: Don't use "it's" at the end of a sentence.

questions.question: "He was buying chocolate." Can we write "He's buying" with the same meaning?
questions.explanation_ar: 's تعني is أو has فقط، وتغيّر الزمن إلى الحاضر.
questions.explanation_en: 's means only is or has; it would change the tense to the present.
